deviation: The draft only covers injunctive relief for misuse of Confidential Information. It has no obligation to keep information confidential, no restriction on use to the NDA's purposes, and no 3-year survival period, so Arcadia's core protection and the playbook's minimum term are missing. If these terms appear elsewhere in the draft, the equitable relief wording is an acceptable addition, but this clause cannot replace the standard.
suggested_text: Each party shall keep the other party's Confidential Information confidential, use it only for the purposes of this NDA, and continue to do so for 3 years after the NDA ends. [Optional addition, if the equitable relief wording is retained:] Each Party acknowledges that unauthorised use or disclosure of Confidential Information may cause irreparable harm for which damages alone would be an inadequate remedy, and that the Discloser is entitled to seek injunctive or other equitable relief without proof of actual damage, in addition to any other remedy available.
